items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: John Ventura had retreads on one of the tires, and they all blew off, and we had to buy new tires.

ctx.x: We had to buy new tires. John Ventura had retreads on one of the tires, and they all blew off, and we had to buy new tires. And -- we were just late.
Coming into New York for the first time.
